verdict: DECISIVE-NEGATIVE / WRONG-BRANCH PATCH. The single-byte compare change did not alter P3, did not register the GPU client, and did not produce P4/PF or ncpy<xfer. It also regressed the round to pure black / xfer=0 / seq0-only at ~275 s. Static post-mortem found the exact reason: the board switch first tests w8<=0xa and handles low WIMG values in a separate branch; VM_WIMG_IO=0x7 never reaches the patched #0x17 comparison. Therefore this round disproves the 'change high-branch comparison' implementation, not the underlying VM_WIMG_IO hypothesis. One-shot package must not be kept; best verified package remains hold/l730.
